name: Parallel
description: Parallel's web APIs (Search, Extract, Task/Deep Research, FindAll, Chat, and Monitor) give AI agents and developers high-quality, low-latency access to the web for research, content extraction, entity discovery, and continuous monitoring.

skills.name: Parallel
skills.description: Use when building AI agents that need to search the web, extract page content, conduct deep research, enrich structured data, discover entities, or monitor the web for changes. Parallel provides APIs for real-time web access, research synthesis, and data enrichment with citations.
